description.zh: 指定收回的实例ID数组。数组长度：1~100。
description.en: The IDs of ECS instances. You can specify 1 to 100 instance IDs.

description.zh: 指定收回的实例RAM角色名称。您可以使用RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~)查询您已创建的实例RAM角色名称。
description.en: The name of the instance RAM role. You can call the [ListRoles](~~28713~~) operation of RAM to query the names of available instance RAM roles.

description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
